anomalies.description: A large explosion erupts near the bus, with a fireball and smoke plume visible as the soldier runs away.
A massive secondary explosion occurs, violently ejecting the soldier into the air; the blast is centered on or near the bus, producing a large fireball and debris cloud.

At least two bright, linear muzzle flashes or projectile trails are visible emerging from the left side of the explosion in frame f0, consistent with rapid-fire weapons discharge during the initial blast.
Multiple armed individuals engage in close-quarters combat among standing stones; visible sword-like weapons and dynamic postures indicate mutual physical combat.
Multiple figures in a rocky terrain are seen holding and aiming firearms; muzzle flashes and dust kicks suggest active gunfire during a combat engagement.
A large, sudden explosion erupts in the mid-ground, sending a plume of smoke, dust, and debris upward and outward; visible as a rapidly expanding fireball and shockwave in frames f3 and f4.
A soldier in tactical gear is crouched beside a burning vehicle; muzzle flash and smoke are visible near their weapon in frames f14–f15, indicating active firing amid the wreckage.

A soldier in full combat gear is engaged in close-quarters physical struggle amid burning wreckage; actions include crouching, bracing, grappling, and manipulating an object (possibly a weapon or device) while surrounded by flames and debris across multiple frames.

A figure appears to be restraining or subduing a prone individual on the ground while flames burn nearby; the posture suggests dominance over a helpless person, though identity and intent are partially obscured by smoke and angle.
A large explosion erupts in the background, sending fire, smoke, and debris into the air, engulfing wreckage on a hillside.
A sudden, violent explosion occurs between two military vehicles in an aerial shot, producing a bright fireball and debris ejection.
